subject: Coordinating compact SOC2 + pen-test corridor — propose staggered 45m blocks
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@corpfinance.com>, security@finprobe.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating compact SOC2 + pen-test corridor — propose staggered 45m blocks

Hi Alice / FinProbe team —

Thanks again for moving this forward. To keep the engagement light for your ops folks and our engineering leads, I'd like to propose a compact 'compliance corridor': three staggered 45-minute blocks spread across one afternoon/evening window so we can run SOC2 evidence review, a short pen-test scope sync, and a DPA Q&A without dragging multiple days.

Proposed slots (all times EST/PST/CET noted inline — tell me which column works best):
- Option A: 2026-11-05 09:00–09:45 ET / 06:00–06:45 PT / 15:00–15:45 CET — fast morning for EU ops
- Option B: 2026-11-05 13:00–13:45 ET / 10:00–10:45 PT / 19:00–19:45 CET — late evening CET-friendly
- Option C: 2026-11-05 17:00–17:45 ET / 14:00–14:45 PT / 23:00–23:45 CET — evening US / very late EU fallback

Proposed cadence inside the corridor: 45m SOC2 evidence walkthrough (controls owners + logs), 45m pen-test scope & rules of engagement (pen vendor + eng lead), 45m DPA question triage (legal/compliance). We can tighten to two 45m blocks if you prefer.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx (snapshot index) — quick reference for the SOC2 slots.

Ben — can you please confirm whether our pen-test lead can join Option B? If not, we can move the vendor slot earlier.

Alice — which option is least disruptive for your regional ops teams? Happy to carve out a different date if 11/05 is rough.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Trust & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@corpfinance.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finprobe.io
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 20:45:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordinating compact SOC2 + pen-test corridor — propose staggered 45m blocks

Hi Mina —

Appreciate the clear corridor idea. Option B (2026-11-05 19:00 CET) looks best for our EU ops team — keeps us in-business-hours. One ask: can we move the pen-test scope to the first 45m rather than middle? Our vendor prefers to set scope before we deep-dive evidence.

Also, can you confirm whether the pen-test will need any pre-authorized IP whitelisting/change tickets for the vendor to start scanning? If so, we need 48 hours' lead time.

Thanks — I can take the calendar ownership once we lock a time.
— Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of IT Risk, CorpFinance
(alice@corpfinance.com)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@corpfinance.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating compact SOC2 + pen-test corridor — propose staggered 45m blocks

Thanks, Mina / Alice.

Ben from Redwood security ops here. Confirming: our pen-test lead, Diego (diego@redwood.com), can join Option B (2026-11-05 19:00 CET). Diego prefers to run the scope + rules-of-engagement first — so Alice's request to put pen-test first aligns with our preference.

Regarding whitelisting: the vendor will need the following pre-reqs if they plan unauthenticated external scans:
- A ticket for outbound IP allowances and 2 static egress IPs (we can provide)
- A short-form authorization email from CorpFinance security contact (alice@...)

We can assemble a one-page pre-req runbook and share it in the calendar invite. Attaching a draft SOW for the pen vendor (PenTest_SOW.pdf) for quick review — this covers basic scope and the scan window limitations.

Proposed final cadence for Option B (if accepted by Alice):
1) 19:00–19:45 CET — Pen test scope & RoE (vendor + Diego)
2) 19:45–20:30 CET — SOC2 evidence walkthrough (controls + logs)
3) 20:30–21:15 CET — DPA Q&A / legal follow-ups

If that fits, Mina — can you / Kimberly generate the calendar block and include the runbook + SOW? Alice said she'll own the event once we lock.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Security Engagements Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PenTest_SOW.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@corpfinance.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordinating compact SOC2 + pen-test corridor — propose staggered 45m blocks

Thanks everyone — locking Option B on behalf of Redwood.

I created a tentative calendar event and included the runbook + SOW links. Event details below and I invited the addresses on thread:
- Title: CorpFinance — Compact Compliance Corridor (SOC2 / PenTest scope / DPA)
- When: 2026-11-05 19:00–21:15 CET (3 x 45m blocks, breaks in between)
- Location: Google Meet (link in event)
- Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx, PenTest_SOW.pdf
- Required: Alice (CorpFinance IT Risk), CorpFinance ops, Redwood pen lead (Diego), Redwood controls owners, Redwood legal (optional)

I also added a short pre-call checklist in the event notes: egress IPs, vendor authorization mail, list of control owners and evidence pointers. If Alice wants to take calendar ownership live, please accept and transfer.

Kimberly Park
Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
